name: Oral Prophylaxis
desc: Professional ultrasonic scaling and polishing to thoroughly remove stubborn plaque, calculus (tartar), and external tea/coffee stains, keeping gums healthy and breath fresh.

name: Tooth Filling
desc: High-grade aesthetic composite resin fillings matched to your natural tooth shade, restoring cavities, chipped surfaces, and minor decay with invisible strength.

name: Tooth Extraction
desc: Gentle and painless tooth removal with modern local anesthesia, catering to severely damaged teeth, baby teeth, and problematic wisdom teeth with fast recovery care.

name: Root Canal Therapy
desc: Advanced endodontic treatment designed to save infected or deeply decayed natural teeth by cleaning and sealing the inner pulp chamber, completely relieving toothache.

name: Orthodontic Braces
desc: Precision metal or ceramic brackets and archwires tailored to guide teeth into perfect alignment, correct bite problems (overbite, underbite), and craft a harmonious smile.

name: Crowns and Bridges
desc: Custom-fabricated ceramic and porcelain caps and fixed bridgework designed to reinforce broken or root-treated teeth and seamlessly replace missing teeth.

name: Removable Dentures
desc: Lightweight, durable complete or partial acrylic and flexible dentures expertly contoured to restore chewing function, speech clarity, and a natural, youthful facial profile.
